about: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells batteries in South Korea, Europe, China, North America, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Energy Solutions and Electronic Materials segments. It offers automotive battery, ESS (Energy Storage System), small-sized li-ion battery used in laptops, tablets, mobile phones, smart watches, earbuds, power tools, outdoor power equipment, vacuum cleaners, e-bikes, e-scooters, and robot; automotive batteries; and energy storage systems for use in residential, utility, commercial, and UPS applications. In addition, the company provides electronic materials, including semiconductor products, such as spin-on hardmasks, spin-on dielectrics, chemical mechanical planarization slurry, extreme ultra violet materials, CMOS image sensor color resist, epoxy molding compounds, and photo imageable dielectric; display materials, such as foldable optical clear adhesive, OLED processing protective films, organic light emitting diode materials, thin film encapsulation, and quantum dot; and battery materials, which includes separators. Further, it manufactures and sells cathode active material for rechargeable battery; and invests in new technology venture business. Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Yongin-Si, South Korea.
